title: Google Search Changes: Publishers & Creators Fear! #shorts
description: Google's search updates are reshaping the internet economy. For publishers and creators, this means fewer clicks and a challenged incentive model. How does the open web survive when search summaries dominate? #GoogleSearch #SEO #DigitalEconomy #OpenWeb #ContentCreation
